verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud provides vendor-maintained monitoring for Kubernetes overview pages, cloud provider infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), application observability, and OpenTelemetry-based agents (Grafana Alloy) covering hosts, containers, and cloud services, plus community validation of multi-source integration breadth (Prometheus, CloudWatch, etc.). missing for 10: explicit list/count of vendor-maintained integrations catalog, independent hands-on validation of Kubernetes/cloud agent setup ease, and confirmation of host-level (e.g. node-exporter style) agent parity with competitors.
